doc.name: SG Parking Live
doc.description: Live HDB carpark availability for Singapore with snapshot history and lookups by carpark code. Free public data, deterministic lookups, MCP tools included. This service is a plain REST API and an MCP server over Streamable HTTP - it is NOT an A2A JSON-RPC agent. Docs at the documentationUrl.

skills.name: health_check
skills.description: Report whether this service is up and which version answered. Use it to confirm the endpoint is reachable before running a real job.

skills.name: list_carparks
skills.description: List HDB carpark codes known from the live Singapore data.gov.sg feed (optionally filtered by code prefix).

skills.name: get_carpark_availability
skills.description: Current lots available per lot type for one HDB carpark code (live from data.gov.sg).

skills.name: get_carpark_history
skills.description: Our stored snapshot history for one carpark code (availability sampled since launch). Deterministic read of our own snapshots.
